title: Investigate and mitigate non-deterministic outputs from prefix KV cache across model+config permutations
creator: Aisha Thompson
description:
Background: We have increasing reports and internal detections where a prefix (KV) cache hit changes model outputs in ways that are not limited to token-level determinism loss but produce semantic differences. These differences surface after model changes, quantization updates, kernel swaps, and when altering runtime config (batching thresholds / attention window heuristics).

Objective: Build a reproducible, automated evaluation and alerting harness that characterizes how prefix cache hits influence functional output across a matrix of model versions and runtime configs, and wire this into PR and deployment gates. Produce mitigations (config defaults, cache invalidation heuristics, and warning-level rollout controls) for regressions deemed high-impact.

Scope: Focus on prefix/KV cache correctness only (not prefix privacy or eviction policy tuning). The system should: 1) detect semantic regressions introduced or exposed by cache hits; 2) quantify sensitivity to config flips (e.g., aggressive batching, short-circuit KV lookup optimizations, token-shifted cache key construction); 3) produce human-readable evidence for triage (diffs, counterexample prompts, token-level traces).
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible harness that runs an evaluation matrix: for each model build (baseline, candidate) and for each runtime config variant, run prompts with cache-forced ON and OFF and produce a per-prompt verdict.
Regression signal quantified with at least three metrics: token edit distance, semantic similarity (embedding cosine), and structured-output predicate mismatch for 5 curated prompt suites.
Automated alerts in Grafana/Slack when a candidate causes >0.5% high-severity semantic regressions on the golden suite compared to baseline, and a PR comment with a stable summary link is created.
Playbook documenting when to invalidate prefix cache, roll back kernel/quantization changes, or gate rollout with canary percentages.
Integration test added to CI: any runtime change that modifies the cache-related code paths must trigger the harness and block merges on P0-level regressions.
Documentation for SRE and Support with reproduction steps and triage checklist.
approach: Create a small 'cache-sensitivity' service that can orchestrate runs: spin baseline container and candidate container, seed the same KV cache state, and execute each prompt both with forced cache-hit and cold-cache scenarios.

Curate 3 golden prompt suites: (1) conversational completions with long prefixes, (2) structured JSON extraction, (3) few-shot code generation. Each suite emphasizes areas where prefix tokens influence downstream generation.
Compute three core signals per prompt: normalized Levenshtein token distance, BERT/embedding cosine similarity, and domain-specific predicate checks (e.g., JSON validity / function name match).
Implement a config-sensitivity matrix runner that toggles runtime flags (batching window, cache-key normalization, early-kv-lookup, quantization mode) and records delta distributions.
Prioritize lightweight deterministic replay infrastructure: store token-level KV hits, attention traces, and kernel selection logs for triage at per-failure granularity.
Design thresholds conservatively at first (e.g., semantic regression > 0.5% on golden suite => investigation), refine after a few runs.
datasets: golden_prefix_suite_v1 (200 prompts, conversational, curated by QA)
developer_code_snippets_small (50 prompts targeting API code gen edge cases)
field-reported-candidates (anonymized customer traces collected under opt-in)
metrics: percent_semantic_regressions (embedding cosine delta > 0.08 mapped to fail)
time_to-reproduce (wall clock from PR to reproducible counterexample)
automation_plan: CI hook: on PR touching runtime/cache/quantization paths, run the harness in a lightweight mode (subset of golden suite) and upload results to an ephemeral dashboard.
Nightly full-matrix sweep: run all model+config permutations against the golden suites and persist historical deltas to the eval datastore.
Alerting: Grafana alert if rolling-24h regression rate > configured threshold; create Slack #runtime-alert thread and auto-post PR ticket link.
PR bot integration: attach summarized artifact (diffs + 3 counterexample prompts) to candidate PRs when regressions exceed thresholds.
Data retention: keep full traces for 90 days; expose TL;DR for engineers with toggleable deep-dive links.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (Dev): deploy harness to staging runtime and run against recent model builds for 2 weeks to tune thresholds (no automated rollbacks).
Phase 2 (Canary): enable PR-gating for runtime changes, block merges on P0-level regressions, require triage notes for P1 regressions.
Phase 3 (Prod safety): wire nightly checks into SRE dashboard and add automated rollback recipes for severe cache-integrity regressions during deployments.
Mitigations: defaulting runtime flag to conservative cache-key normalization; fallback to cold-cache path for requests flagged by canary rules.
Owner/Oncall: runtime-team + evaluation-team shared pager for critical alerts during rollout window.
